curriculum.scope: Repository-wide curriculum construction and lesson-review queue state; does not represent Technician credential release approval.

assessment.scope: Development/public academic assessment capability and private-store integration contracts are implemented. Candidate-bank depth is complete; operational item-bank population, active-item depth, human assessment review, pilot statistics, form-equivalence evidence and real secure-store approval remain fail-closed.

runtime.scope: Repository production persistence adapter composition is implemented and transaction-tested, but productionPersistenceAdapter remains false until a live PostgreSQL deployment, migrations, secret delivery, failure/retry behavior and operational validation are completed.

credentials.scope: Credential runtime foundation includes transaction-tested revocation code and a managed external signing-provider integration contract. Production issuer identity, production signing and deployed revocation persistence remain false until real infrastructure, key custody/security validation and program release approval exist.

accessibility.scope: Automated accessibility requirements are implemented, but rendered/manual WCAG and responsive approval remains open.

operations.scope: Repository release controls exist; production operational approval requires deployed environment, persistence, backup/restore, monitoring, and release evidence.

readinessScope.canonicalAuthority: Certification repository registries and executable gates
readinessScope.academicPublicationBoundary: Public academic availability does not imply professional credential approval or issuance readiness.
readinessScope.credentialReleaseBoundary: Technician I and Technician II release evidence ledgers remain authoritative for occupational validation, assessment validation, pilot, standard-setting, security/privacy, and final issuance approval.
